Reads the index again and pins the key it names. keyId must be the fingerprint the preview showed, otherwise the answer is 409 KEY_MISMATCH and nothing is saved. Every plugin installed from it must be signed by that key.

  as={"h2"}

>

<StatusCodes
  responses={{"200":{"description":"The added registry."},"400":{"description":"Not an https URL, no publicKey, or too many registries."},"403":{"description":"The caller lacks admin.plugins.manage."},"409":{"description":"Already added, or the key changed since the preview."},"502":{"description":"The index could not be read."}}}
>
  
</StatusCodes>
